name: Joan Penridge Commemorative Award
summary: A scholarship for full-time domestic QUT nursing students in their final year.
key: Valued at $3,000, paid as $1,500 per teaching period for up to one year.
who: Australian or NZ citizen or Australian permanent resident.
In the final year of the Bachelor of Nursing (NS42) or an eligible combined nursing degree.
how: Apply with the application form and a response to the selection criteria. You may be interviewed.
catches: Offered from Semester 2, 2026. Ask health.engage@qut.edu.au for the closing date.

evidence.quote: The Joan Penridge Commemorative Award ('the Scholarship'), valued at $3,000, is offered to continuing domestic students.
Must be enrolled as a full-time student at QUT (36 credit points or above).
